init.title: Custom screens
init.description: Templates for up to 4 custom screens. Each one with text joins the display rotation after the regular screens and updates whenever its template changes. Leave a field empty to remove that screen. Example: `{example}`. Long text scrolls. Needs firmware with custom screen support.

confirm.title: Remove the old HomeBrainz integration
confirm.description:
The HomeBrainz integration is now called inkVision, and your devices were moved to it. HACS left the old integration's folder behind at `{path}`, where it can still discover devices as "HomeBrainz". Until it is gone, the old entries stay under HomeBrainz as disabled; they are removed automatically afterwards.

Select **Submit** to delete the folder, then restart Home Assistant.

legacy_service.title: The {old} action was renamed
legacy_service.description: An automation or script called `{old}`. It still works for now, but please change it to `{new}`, then ignore this notice.

legacy_duplicate.title: {title} is set up twice
legacy_duplicate.description: {title} was added to inkVision and also still exists under the old HomeBrainz name. Remove the HomeBrainz entry under **Settings** > **Devices & services**.
